questionText: In triangle $ABC$, side $a = 7\text{ cm}$, side $b = 5\text{ cm}$, and angle $C = 52°$. Find the length of side $c$, correct to two decimal places.
markingScheme:
Identify cosine rule as the correct approach **(1 mark)**
Substitute values correctly: $c^2 = 7^2 + 5^2 - 2(7)(5)\cos 52°$ **(2 marks)**
Evaluate to obtain $c^2 \approx 30.91$ **(1 mark)**
Final answer $c \approx 5.56\text{ cm}$ **(1 mark)**

solutionSteps.explanation: Two sides and the included angle are given, so the cosine rule applies: $c^2 = a^2 + b^2 - 2ab\cos C$.
